basic_info.description: Iconic views await from this elegant full floor co-op with a magnificent Russian Hill location. Spectacular panoramic downtown, bridge, Bay, and City views are enjoyed from the stately living room (with fireplace); from the gracious dining room; from the tranquil primary bedroom suite; from the lovely balcony, and even from the warm and inviting writer's alcove. While many other luxury cooperative apartments are graced with lovely vistas, the impact of the views from this architectural masterpiece must be experienced in person to truly be appreciated. The well-conceived eat-in kitchen is graced with west facing natural light and a balanced combination of urban and natural vistas. Form and function are all well balanced by the combination of fine wood cabinets, timeless stone counters, and top brand appliances. There is also a pantry nook with a wet bar, an in-unit laundry room, as well as an additional west facing bedroom and adjoining bathroom; with two more bedrooms that share a Jack and Jill bathroom. Graceful moldings, hardwood floors, voluminous rooms, a thoughtful and efficient floor plan and assigned garage parking are but a few of the additional features and amenities that await you.
